- Fixture construction samples include the independent oracle arrays and wrappers, and initial class loading for the first shape. Treat them as diagnostics, not isolated production construction latency.
- Fresh cursor means a newly allocated object with warmed JVM code; this does not measure cold JVM startup.
- The first 4/9/32 run and the paired 8/11/64 run are retained separately. A single machine and two process pairs do not support a general deployment speedup claim.
- The initial candidate shows a deliberate CPU/allocation tradeoff; inspect per-case regression rows before choosing a workload policy.
